page.overview:
Who is Bobby Baird?

He drove in several non-championship races, with third places in the Ulster Trophy and the Snetterton Coronation Trophy his best results, both coming in 1953. He was killed in his final race at Snetterton in 1953, where he rolled his car, breaking a rib which would puncture his lungs and heart.
